limitations: Unsupported bounded walks and completed unsuccessful walks remain distinct unknowns, not negative route certificates.
No powered forecast starts in the live corpus; the four diagnostic successes are completed off the live deadline in existing fixtures.
The two new extended positives arrive after the original cover search deadline and do not change controls, captures or armed losses.
Two generated worlds and seat swaps are a small correlated sample. Receipt and publication counts are not independent physical successes.
Snapshot and synchronous validation costs remain outside operation quotas; no Pi performance claim.
